name: showreel-c3-fix-invite

voice.text: Everything here is shouting. Nothing stands out, so nothing gets read. Turns out, it needs one hero. First, make the age the biggest thing. Next, keep one font in two sizes. Then, use one colour, just once. Same party, and now you can read it.

caption:
Everything on this birthday invite is shouting. Nothing stands out, so nothing gets read. 🎈

1. Make the age the biggest thing. One hero.
2. Keep one font in two sizes.
3. Use one colour, just once.

Save this for your next invite, poster or flyer. Which of these does yours break?

sources.title: Visual Hierarchy in UX: Definition (Nielsen Norman Group)
Typography in ten minutes (Butterick's Practical Typography)

edges_ok.why: the design-tutorial stage (a fridge door) fills the frame by design

before.mistake: a first-draft party invite: four fonts, everything centred, confetti in six colours, and no one thing that stands out
